class.name: CSSStyleDeclaration
class.brief_description: An editable declaration block for a CSS style rule.
class.description: Obtain a declaration block from [member CSSRule.style]. Values are serialized CSS tokens. Mutations update the current layout and invalidate existing CSS rule and declaration handles for that stylesheet; they do not change the source HTML or CSS resource.

method.name: get_css_text
method.description: Returns the serialized declarations, or an empty string for a stale handle.

method.name: get_length
method.description: Returns the number of unique property names in this declaration block.

method.name: get_property_priority
method.description: Returns [code]important[/code] when the named declaration has [code]!important[/code], or an empty string otherwise.

method.name: get_property_value
method.description: Returns the last declared value for [param name], or an empty string when it is absent or this handle is stale.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns whether the owning rule and stylesheet revision are still valid.

method.name: item
method.description: Returns the property name at [param index], or an empty string for an invalid index.

method.name: remove_property
method.description: Removes all declarations named [param name] and returns the previous value. A successful edit invalidates this declaration handle.

method.name: set_css_text
method.description: Replaces the declaration block with declarations parsed from [param text]. A successful edit invalidates this handle.

method.name: set_property
method.description: Sets a CSS property. Pass [code]important[/code] as [param priority] to add [code]!important[/code]. Unsupported priority strings are ignored. A successful edit invalidates this handle.

members.member: Number of declarations in this block.
Whether the declaration block handle is current.
